name: Copper
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For Copper, run a basic sales pipeline closely tied to Google Workspace data. The hard boundary is gmail and calendar integration, automatic activity capture, reporting, and support, plus integrations, data quality, and workflow lock-in.
